language.name: English
app.title: CoWorker
app.subtitle: Ask a coding question or request a focused change in the current workspace.
runtime.connecting_title: Connecting to the local CoWorker runtime
runtime.connecting_body: The launcher opened the desktop app and the frontend is waiting for backend config and provider state. If this takes too long, check the launcher terminal output first.
runtime.error_title: The local runtime is not ready yet
runtime.error_body: The app no longer stays on a silent blank page. Check the launcher output for backend or Electron errors to decide whether the failure is in backend startup, frontend assets, or the Electron load path.
chat.backend_unreachable: CoWorker backend is not reachable. Please restart the desktop launcher.
chat.work_plan_tip: Plan mode: read-only research, ask for intent, produce a plan for approval
chat.work_build_tip: Build mode: work autonomously within the workspace, ask per autonomy
chat.autonomy_guarded_tip: Work freely inside the workspace, ask only at the boundary
chat.autonomy_autonomous_tip: Work fully autonomously, never ask the user
chat.stopped: Stopped waiting in the frontend. If the backend already started, its response will be ignored.
chat.command_goal: Set an autonomous goal and keep working until achieved
chat.command_help_text: Available commands: /help shows help, /new starts a new chat, /clear clears the chat, /goal sets an autonomous goal, /providers opens providers, /settings opens settings.
chat.goal_help_text: Usage: /goal <description>. Sets a persistent goal the agent works toward autonomously until achieved. Include verifiable completion criteria.
chat.goal_paused_message: Goal paused — click Resume to continue.
chat.command_approval_waiting: Command approval is pending. Approve or reject it in Settings > Tool Audit.
chat.mcp_approval_destructive: The server marked this tool as destructive; it may make irreversible changes.
theme.preset_mineral_desc: Cool mineral blue-gray for long coding sessions.
theme.preset_hermes_desc: Leather, paper, and warm copper studio tones.
theme.preset_ember_desc: Low-light ember colors for action-heavy work.
theme.preset_sage_desc: Soft green tones that reduce interface fatigue.
theme.preset_graphite_desc: High-contrast grayscale with a terminal-tool feel.
theme.preset_custom_desc: Use your own CoWorker color palette.
settings.title: Settings
settings.heading: Application Settings
settings.description: Manage interface preferences, theme, and chat defaults in one place.
settings.interface_group_desc: Control CoWorker's display language and visual theme.
settings.theme_desc: Choose light, dark, or the system appearance.
settings.appearance_desc: Control light, dark, or system appearance.
settings.palette_group_desc: Choose a CoWorker palette, or switch to Custom to edit key colors.
settings.palette_entry_desc: Open a second-level page to choose theme styles and configure custom colors.
settings.translucent_theme_desc: Adds a translucent frosted material across the interface, similar to Apple glass panels.
settings.custom_palette_desc: These colors override the core CSS variables for the current appearance.
settings.composer_group_desc: These defaults stay synchronized with the composer controls.
settings.work_mode_desc: Plan is for reasoning first; Build is for implementation work.
settings.autonomy_desc: Confirm-each asks before every action; Guarded works freely inside the workspace and asks only at the boundary; Autonomous never asks.
settings.goal_group_desc: Configure the advancement cap for autonomous goals (/goal).
settings.goal_rounds_desc: How many steps the autonomous goal loop may advance. Unlimited = no cap; Default = 50 steps; Custom lets you enter a specific step count (1–1000).
settings.attachment_group_desc: Control the size limit for attachments sent with a message.
settings.max_attachment_mb_desc: Attachments larger than this are not inlined (only metadata is kept; the model decides whether to use them). Default 25 MB, customizable 1–1024 MB.
settings.audit_group_desc: Review Agent stage traces, approval state, and recent tool safety audit records.
settings.audit_entry_desc: Review pending approvals, Agent stage traces, and tool safety audit records.
settings.audit_load_failed: Failed to load runtime observability records
providers.title: Provider Management
providers.heading: AI Provider Management
providers.description: Configure AI providers for CoWorker's model calls.
providers.default_model_desc: Select which provider and model CoWorker should use.
providers.quick_add_desc: Select a template to pre-fill provider details.
providers.name: Name
providers.api_key_saved: Saved key will be kept if left blank.
providers.fetch_models_hint: Click the refresh button to fetch available models from this provider.
providers.delete_confirm: Deleting this provider will remove it permanently.
providers.empty_hint: Click a template above to add one quickly.
error.fetch_failed: Network request failed. Please check whether the CoWorker backend is running.
error.connection_refused: Connection refused. Please make sure the CoWorker backend has started.
error.electron_api_unavailable: Electron bridge is unavailable. Please open the app through the desktop launcher.
error.skill_delete_not_in_root: Cannot delete this skill: its location ('{path}') is outside the recognized skill directories. Please remove it from the application's own settings or delete the symlink manually.
error.skill_delete_no_skill_md: Cannot delete: SKILL.md not found in the skill directory.
error.skill_fetch_empty: Failed to fetch skill file (downloaded content is empty).
inspector.title: Context
bottom_panel.command_placeholder: Run a workspace command; first run requires Settings approval
sidebar.project_delete_confirm: Deleting the project will also delete all of its sessions. Continue?
project_dialog.title: Create Project
project_dialog.description: Choose a local folder as CoWorker's actual working directory.
project_dialog.pick_workspace: Choose or create a project folder
project_dialog.workspace_hint: The agent will read, edit, and run commands in this folder: {path}
new_chat.title: What can I help you with today?
new_chat.subtitle_workspace: Start a conversation in the {name} workspace
new_chat.subtitle_empty: Pick a workspace first, then start the conversation
first_run.title: Create a project before CoWorker starts working
first_run.description: The project workspace decides where the agent reads, edits, and runs commands. Choose a folder first, then every new session belongs to that project.
empty_project.title: {name} has no sessions yet
empty_project.description: This project is bound to a workspace. Once you start the first task, the session will appear under the project.
message.rollback_confirm: Revert this message? It and all following replies will be removed.
changes.title: Changes
changes.no_git: This workspace is not a Git repository; showing session changes only.
rollback.title: Confirm rollback
rollback.description: The target message and everything after it will be removed. You may also revert the code changes those messages produced.
rollback.no_code_changes: No code changes were produced after this message.
rollback.result_with_conflicts: Reverted {reverted} change(s); {conflicts} conflicted with other sessions/manual edits and were skipped.

mcp.env_desc: Key-value environment variables to inject (e.g. API keys).
mcp.empty_hint: Click a template above to add one quickly.
mcp.delete_confirm: Deleting this server will remove it permanently.
mcp.no_tools: No tools discovered yet (test connection to discover).
mcp.catalog_desc: Browse all available MCP services. Select a service to pre-configure it.
mcp.headers_desc: Common for remote server auth (e.g. Authorization: Bearer xxx).
mcp.tpl.filesystem.name: Filesystem
mcp.tpl.filesystem.desc: Secure file read/write/edit within sandboxed directories
mcp.tpl.git.name: Git
mcp.tpl.git.desc: Commit history, diffs, blame, and branch management
mcp.tpl.context7.name: Context7
mcp.tpl.context7.desc: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries
mcp.tpl.deepwiki.name: DeepWiki
mcp.tpl.deepwiki.desc: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository
mcp.tpl.sequential-thinking.name: Sequential Thinking
mcp.tpl.memory-server.name: Memory Server
mcp.tpl.memory-server.desc: Knowledge graph memory for persistent context
mcp.tpl.playwright.name: Playwright
mcp.tpl.playwright.desc: Browser automation, screenshots, and web scraping
mcp.tpl.everything-server.name: Everything (reference)
mcp.tpl.everything-server.desc: Official reference server exercising the full MCP spec
skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Reusable instruction packs (Agent Skills) loaded on demand
skills.empty: No skills found. Create SKILL.md under .coworker/skills or .agents/skills.
skills.validate_placeholder: Enter a skill directory or SKILL.md path
skills.slash_usage: Usage: /skill <name> [task]. e.g. /skill git-release create a 1.2.0 release.
skills.slash_loaded: Skill loaded: {name}. Follow the instructions below strictly:
skills.custom_create_desc: Create a custom skill from a template
skills.delete_confirm: Delete skill '{name}'? This removes all of its files and cannot be undone.
skills.open_file_hint: Open SKILL.md in the editor to view the full content
memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Persistent notes the agent remembers across sessions: project preferences, conventions, and user facts. Edits here are injected into every chat.
memory.add_placeholder: e.g. The team deploys to staging on Fridays.
memory.proposals_empty: No pending proposals. They appear after enough turns when auto-extract is on.
